q.line: She means we're bouncing into Graceland
stanza: There is a girl in New York City
Who calls herself the human trampoline
And sometimes when I'm falling, flying
Or tumbling in turmoil I say
"Whoa, so this is what she means"
She means we're bouncing into Graceland

partner.line: Or tumbling in turmoil I say

stanza: There's some part of me wants to see Graceland
